name: Spectra Alpha v2
intent: Premium graphite chrome finish; hero should feel printed onto polished material, not covered by wallpaper.
notes: V2 intentionally lowers graphite base opacity compared to V1 so the hero image does not become a dark wallpaper.
Reflection and film are the signature layers; tune those before touching layout.
If it still looks like haze, lower base to 0.24 and raise reflection to 0.28.
If it looks too rainbow, lower film to 0.10.
